description: Rez (United Game Artists, 2001), recompiled for the TrimUI Brick.
features: 60 fps: the stages are drawn at 60 frames a second, where the original draws them at 30.
Resolution: 1024x768 (the Brick's screen) or 640x480, set in Options.
Vibration: Off, Low, Medium or High, set in Options.
LEDs: they pulse with the game's vibration in the colour on screen, Off, Back Only or All, and their brightness, set in Options. Rez's own vibration (its Options) must be on.
Controls: every button can be remapped, set in Options.
changelog: Options: Vibration, LEDs and LED Brightness say that Vibration must be ON in the in-game settings (shown by Deadcast 1.2.7 or newer).
